fonts.display: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Instrument Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary headings, body text, and icon fills on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary text, heading color, deep UI surfaces — slightly warmer than pure black

palette.name: Slate Mid
palette.role: Body text, helper copy, muted descriptions

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Hairline borders across cards, inputs, images, and dividers

palette.name: Pebble
palette.role: Disabled button background, body borders — the lightest non-surface gray

palette.name: Cloud
palette.role: Elevated surface tier, button borders, subtle fills

palette.name: Snow
palette.role: Card surface background — one step off white for gentle separation

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, input fields, icon fills, reversed text on dark elements

palette.name: Fern
palette.role: Accent text, decorative punctuation in body copy, gradient flash color — the only chromatic voice, rationed carefully

palette.name: Mint Wash
palette.role: Pale green surface tint, decorative wash blocks
